statements.subject: server
statements.description: For this reason, the PREAUTH response SHOULD only be returned by servers on connections that are protected by TLS (such as on an Implicit TLS port [RFC8314]) or protected through other means such as IPsec.
statements.trigger: connection startup greeting sent as PREAUTH
actions: return PREAUTH response only on TLS-protected or equivalently protected connection

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients that require mandatory TLS MUST close the connection after receiving the PREAUTH response on a non-protected port.
statements.trigger: PREAUTH response received on non-protected port
